create_CpuCommunicator: create a CpuCommunicator instance for CPU-based distributed communication with a ProcessGroup
run_all_reduce: run an all-reduce operation on a tensor across all ranks in a CPU distributed group
run_all_gather: run an all-gather operation to collect tensors from all ranks into a single concatenated tensor
send_recv_tensor_dict: send and receive a dictionary of tensors between ranks using shared memory fastpath
dispatch_router_logits: dispatch hidden states and router logits to appropriate devices using the all2all manager
